link.quote: With five of us here, my departure alone leaves four; would someone else prefer to visit North House or another place?

proposedRemedy.quote: I'll head there and offer a shift next cycle. We can share that work rather than leave it to the same people.

enactedRemedy.act: moved to North House at c27, which ended the cycle with three in South House (Gale and Heath had gone to the workshop; first shifts c28)
enactedRemedy.quote: I'll visit North House now, leaving three here and avoiding the extra heat use.
